name: FollowUpAgreement
title: Follow-up Form
description: Agreement by the client and guardians to support the one-year follow-up process after discharge, with the undertakings each party accepts and the people who sign it.

item.text: The programme is designed to help clients set their feet on the right path and enjoy life to the full while overcoming challenges in a healthy manner — shown through total abstinence from all mood-altering substances, improved physical health and psychological stability. Utmost honesty and cooperation from both the client and the guardian is paramount.

Progress is assessed over one year: the client returns for a first review two weeks after discharge, a second review two weeks after that, and then reports monthly for the remaining eleven months to review with their primary counsellor.
Undertakings
That they will be receiving phone calls only from the centre's administration.
That they will be sincere and honest about the progress of their loved ones.
That they will ensure the client visits the recommended referral agents.
That they will ensure a client with prescribed medication continues to use it exactly as prescribed by a doctor.
That the client will visit the centre when and if called upon to do so.
That the client or guardian will keep the discharge summary form safe for future reference and for continuity of treatment.
That the client will take part in family fellowships and other fellowships, such as Alcoholics Anonymous meetings in their town, to help them grow spiritually.
That in case of any problem in the recovery process, the client or guardian will inform the centre.
